title: Smile and House
author: Lior Winterbourne
blurb: Cyrus Almeida, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
